name: nc_general_statute
description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the North Carolina General Statutes — North Carolina state law — by citation. "N.C.G.S. 14-17" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text with a data_as_of timestamp. Keyless. Use for "what does North Carolina General Statute 14-17 say" or to check an NC statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "14-17" or "20-138.1". The chapter is the part before the first dash.

name: nc_statute_search
description: Search North Carolina General Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "election conduct at polling places", "landlord retaliatory eviction", "concealed handgun permit". Returns ranked sections with their citations; use nc_general_statute afterward for the full text of one. Full-text search, so it answers questions no citation lookup can. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "election conduct at polling places".
